blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-resolution digital elevation models (DEMs) support Earth observation applications, but paired training references are often available only at coarser output resolutions. Reconstructing finer terrain grids therefore requires both effective transfer beyond the supervised scale and control of dense-query computation. To address this problem, SCOPE learns a continuous terrain representation from coarser-resolution pairs. It predicts a latent coefficient field on the low-resolution grid and reuses local Fourier residual functions through basis evaluation and geometry-guided ensemble fusion. This separates high-dimensional coefficient prediction from output-grid construction. Experiments on geographically distributed land–ocean samples assess supervised reconstruction, unseen-scale inference, cross-domain generalization, and theoretical computation. SCOPE leads the compared methods across six metrics in the main supervised-scale evaluation. At an unseen factor three times the training factor, land reconstruction reduces RMSE and MAE by approximately 12% relative to bicubic interpolation, with errors close to target-scale fine-tuning. Ninefold output density increases counted multiply–accumulate operations by only about 2%. Frozen-model validation on held-out external marine regions reduces RMSE relative to the DEM-specific implicit baseline EBCF-CDEM by approximately 19% under self-downsampling and 2% with cross-product inputs, while also yielding lower RMSE than LIIF-MS in both settings. These results demonstrate the value of reusable coefficient fields for accurate reconstruction beyond the supervised resolution with low incremental arithmetic cost.
blocks.zh: 高分辨率数字高程模型(DEMs)支持对地观测应用,但配对的训练参考材料往往只在较短的输出分辨率中提供。 因此,要重建更细的地形网,就需要在有监督的尺度之外进行有效的转移,还需要控制密集的热量计算。 为了解决这一问题,SCOPE从较近分辨率的对子中学习到连续的地形代表. 它预测低分辨率网格上的潜在系数场,并通过基础评价和几何制导的聚变再利用当地的傅里叶残留功能. 这把高维系数预测与输出-网格构造分开. 在地理分布的陆地上进行的实验 -- -- 海洋样本评估了有监督的重建、未见规模的推论、跨域归纳和理论计算。 在主要监督规模评价中,SCOPE在6个衡量标准上牵头采用比较方法。 在未见的系数中,土地重建使RMSE和MAE相对于双立体插值减少了约12%,错误接近目标规模的微调. 输出密度增加9倍计算成倍积分操作只增加约2%. 对搁置的外部海洋区域的冷冻模型验证使RMSE相对于DEM特定隐含基线EBCF-CDEM在自下采样下减少约19%,对跨产品投入减少2%,同时在这两种情况下RMSE也比LIIF-MS低。 这些结果表明,在有监督的解析度之外,可重新使用的系数字段对于准确重建的价值低。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 1.1 DEM Products and Limited Target-Resolution Supervision
blocks.zh: 1.1 DEM 产品和有限目标分辨率监督

blocks.en: Digital elevation models (DEMs) and bathymetric grids are fundamental Earth observation products for terrain interpretation, hydrologic modeling, hazard assessment, coastal management, and marine resource exploration ( Miller and Laflamme, 1958 ; Moore et al., 1991 ; Smith and Sandwell, 1997 ) . The spatial resolution required by these applications is not always supported by the available observations. Satellite missions such as SRTM and TanDEM-X have improved terrestrial elevation coverage ( Farr et al., 2007 ; Krieger et al., 2007 ; Wessel et al., 2018 ) , whereas marine observations remain more spatially incomplete. The GEBCO_2024 release reports that 26.1% of the global seabed had been mapped using modern survey techniques ( GEBCO, 2024 ) ; extensive regions rely on bathymetric estimates inferred from satellite-altimetry-derived gravity anomalies ( Tozer et al., 2019 ; Smith and Sandwell, 1994 ) .
blocks.zh: 数字高程模型(DEMs)和测深网是地球观测的基础产品,用于地形解释、水文模型制作、危险评估、沿海管理和海洋资源勘探(Miller and Laflamme,1958年;Moore等人,1991年;Smith and Sandwell,1997年)。 这些应用所要求的空间分辨率并不总是得到现有观测数据的支持。 诸如SRTM和TanDEM-X等卫星飞行任务提高了地面海拔覆盖率(Farr等人,2007年;Krieger等人,2007年;Wessel等人,2018年),而海洋观测空间仍然比较不完整。 GEBCO_2024的释放报告,全球海底的26.1%是使用现代勘测技术绘制的(GEBCO,2024年);大片区域依靠从卫星-时空引力异常推断出的测深估计(Tozer等人,2019年;Smith和Sandwell,1994年)。

blocks.en: Airborne LiDAR, photogrammetry, interferometric SAR, and shipborne acoustic surveys can provide detailed terrain observations, but acquisition cost, sensor characteristics, and uneven coverage constrain their availability. Consequently, paired DEMs may support learning at a coarser output resolution even when reference data at the desired finer resolution are unavailable for training. The practical question is whether these available pairs can support reconstruction beyond interpolation at a finer target grid, without requiring new target-scale training labels. In this study, limited target-resolution supervision denotes learning from paired elevation references at a coarser output resolution than the desired reconstruction grid.
blocks.zh: 空载LiDAR,摄影测量,干涉合成孔径雷达,以及船载声学测量可以提供详细的地形观测,但获取成本,传感器特征和覆盖范围不均匀限制了它们的可用性. 因此,配对的DEM可能支持在较短的输出分辨率上学习,即使培训时没有理想的更细分辨率的参考数据。 实际的问题是,这些可用的对子是否能够支持重建,超越在更细的目标网格上的插值,而不需要新的目标规模培训标签. 在这项研究中,有限的目标分辨率监督意味着从比预期的重建网格更短距离输出分辨率的对称高程参考中学习。

blocks.en: 1.2 Limitations of Fixed-Scale DEM Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 1.2 固定规模德国马克的限制 重建

blocks.en: Classical DEM enhancement uses interpolation, geostatistical estimation, multi-source fusion, and terrain examples to construct denser elevation grids ( Yang et al., 2019 ; Straub, 2012 ; Yue et al., 2015 ) . Deep learning approaches have adapted convolutional, residual, adversarial, attention-based, and Transformer architectures to DEM reconstruction ( Dong et al., 2014 ; Xu et al., 2019 ; Demiray et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ) . DEM-specific models further exploit terrain decomposition, frequency separation, shaded relief, and hydrological or uncertainty-related information ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 古典DEM增强法采用内插法,地理统计估计,多源聚变,地形实例构建更密集的海拔网格(Yang等人,2019年;Straub,2012年;Yue等人,2015年). 深层次的学习方法使革命,残余,对抗性,关注性,变形器建筑适应DEM重建(董等,2014年;徐等,2019年;戴米雷等,2021年;周等,2021年;张等,2022年). DEM特定模型进一步利用地形分解、频率分离、荫蔽减轻和水文或不确定性相关信息(Wang等人,2024年;Wen等人,2025年;Huang等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Many learned grid-to-grid approaches, including the fixed-scale configurations of EDSR, SwinIR, and HAT, optimize a mapping to a predefined output grid. Changing the reconstruction factor commonly requires a different output head or another training configuration with appropriate target-scale examples. Interpolation can produce arbitrary grid spacings without such training, but does not learn terrain-dependent corrections from paired observations. Thus, output-grid flexibility and learned elevation reconstruction need to be considered together when the desired resolution exceeds the available supervision.
blocks.zh: 许多学习到的网格对网格方法,包括EDSR,SwinIR和HAT的固定尺度配置,优化了映射到预定义输出网格. 改变重建因子通常需要不同的输出头或另一个训练配置,并有适当的目标规模实例. 内插可以在没有这种训练的情况下产生任意的网格间距,但不从配对观测中学习地形依赖的校正. 因此,在所期望的解决方案超过现有监督时,需要同时考虑产出网的灵活性和学到的高度重建。

blocks.en: 1.3 Continuous Terrain Representation
blocks.zh: 1.3 连续地面代表

blocks.en: Continuous representations offer a way to separate the output sampling grid from the learned terrain function. Coordinate-conditioned models evaluate elevations at requested spatial locations, while Fourier feature mappings and sinusoidal representations provide tools for representing spatial variation ( Tancik et al., 2020 ; Sitzmann et al., 2020 ) . Meta-SR, LIIF, LTE, and CiaoSR explore arbitrary-scale image reconstruction using scale-conditioned filters, local implicit functions, frequency-aware estimation, and neighborhood aggregation ( Hu et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Lee and Jin, 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) . Continuous DEM and LIIF-style elevation models have likewise established arbitrary-coordinate terrain reconstruction ( He et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 持续的表示提供了一种将输出采样网格与学习的地形功能区分开来的方法. 具备坐标条件的模型在所要求的空间位置评价海拔,而Fourier特征绘图和sinusoid表示则提供了代表空间变异的工具(Tancik等人,2020年;Sitzmann等人,2020年)。 Meta-SR,LIIF,LTE,和CiaoSR 探索任意规模图像重建,使用标定条件的滤波器,局部隐含功能,频率感知估计,以及邻里聚合(Hu等人,2019年;Chen等人,2021年;Lee and Jin,2022年;Cao等人,2023年). 持续的DEM和LIIF式高地模型同样建立了任意的坐标地形重建(He等人,2022年;Yao等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: These approaches share flexible coordinate querying but differ in the predicted quantities and their computational roles. LIIF predicts values from local features and query coordinates; LTE uses query-centered frequency-aware estimation; EBCF-CDEM predicts an elevation bias relative to a nearest-neighbor terrain base. These mechanisms provide relevant baselines for examining both reconstruction accuracy and the work repeated at each output coordinate. Continuous query capability alone does not establish the accuracy of a model beyond its training scales, and a larger number of output queries can also increase the repeated decoding cost.
blocks.zh: 这些方法共享灵活的坐标查询,但预测数量及其计算作用有所不同。 LIIF从局部特征和查询坐标预测值;LTE使用以查询为中心的频率感知估计;EBCF-CDEM预测相对于近邻地形基础的海拔偏差. 这些机制为审查重建的准确性和每个产出协调处重复的工作提供了相关基线。 仅靠持续查询能力并不能确定一个模型超出训练规模的准确性,更多的产出查询也会增加重复的解码成本.

blocks.en: 1.4 From Coordinate Querying to Reusable Terrain Functions
blocks.zh: 1.4 从坐标查询到可重复使用的地面函数

blocks.en: To what extent can a continuous terrain representation learned under coarser-resolution supervision sustain reconstruction accuracy at finer, unseen scales without target-scale retraining or substantial growth in computational cost? The evaluation jointly examines reconstruction accuracy outside the supervised scale and computational growth as the output grid becomes denser.
blocks.zh: 在较窄分辨率监督下获得的持续地形代表性在多大程度上能够维持重建精度更精细、没有目标规模的再培训或计算成本的大幅增长? 该评价联合审查受监督规模之外的重建精度,并随着产出网格密度增加而计算增长。

blocks.en: To address this problem, SCOPE predicts a latent coefficient field on the low-resolution (LR) feature grid. The coefficients parameterize local Fourier residual functions that are reused across output coordinates. Local basis evaluation and a geometry-guided Local Attentive Ensemble (LAE) combine neighboring residual candidates over a bicubic base surface. This shifts high-dimensional coefficient prediction to the LR grid and leaves a lightweight evaluation task at the query stage. The central distinction is therefore the predicted object and the allocation of repeated computation, rather than the use of Fourier functions in isolation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,SCOPE预测低分辨率(LR)特征网格上的潜在系数域. 系数参数化的Fourier本地残余功能跨输出坐标重用. 局部基础评价与几何制导的局部姿态组合(LAE)将邻近的残余候选者结合在一个双立体基面上. 这把高维系数预测转移到LR网格上,并在查询阶段留下轻量级的评价任务. 因此,中心区别是预测对象和重复计算的分配,而不是孤立使用傅里叶函数.

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: 1. A reconstruction study under limited target-resolution supervision examines whether a model learned from coarser LR–HR pairs can reconstruct a finer target grid without target-scale retraining, distinguishing output-grid flexibility from demonstrated scale extrapolation. 2. A reusable coefficient-field formulation concentrates high-dimensional prediction on the LR grid and reconstructs elevation residuals through local basis evaluation and geometry-guided fusion, reducing the arithmetic work repeated across dense output coordinates. 3. An evaluation combines supervised-scale accuracy, unseen-scale reconstruction, and theoretical operation counts with external cross-domain tests. The external tests distinguish cross-region generalization under synthetic degradation from transfer to matched inputs drawn from a different DEM product.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概述如下: 1. 在有限目标分辨率监督下进行的一项重建研究审查从Cearser LR-HR配对中学习的模型是否能够重建一个更精细的目标网格而不进行目标规模的再培训,从而将输出网格的灵活性与所显示的规模推算区分开来。 2. 可重复使用的系数场配方将高维度预测集中在LR网格上,并通过局部基础评价和几何导聚变重建海拔残基,减少跨密集输出坐标重复的算术工作. 3. 一项评价将监督尺度的准确性、无形规模的重建、理论操作计数与外部跨域测试相结合。 外部测试将合成降解下的跨区域通用性与从不同德国马克产品中提取的匹配投入相区别。

Section 4 reports the experimental setup, baseline comparison, ablation studies, and qualitative analyses. Section 5 discusses implications and limitations. Section 6 concludes the paper.

blocks.en: 2 Data and Study Design
blocks.zh: 2 数据和研究设计

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Sources
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据来源

blocks.en: Two complementary data collections are used: a main land–ocean collection for supervised reconstruction and scale-transfer experiments, and a held-out marine collection for frozen-model external evaluation. Table 1 summarizes their source products and experimental roles. Figure 3 maps source-product coverage and regional extents, while Secs. 2.2 and 2.3 describe sample construction and the evaluated subsets.
blocks.zh: 使用了两个补充数据收集:一个是用于监督重建和规模转移实验的主要陆地-海洋数据收集,另一个是用于冷冻模型外部评估的搁置的海洋数据收集。 表1概述了其源产品和实验作用。 图3绘制了源产品覆盖面和区域范围,而第2.2和第2.3节描述了样品构造和所评价的子集。

blocks.en: The elevation products integrated in this study include global terrestrial DEMs, global background bathymetry, and regional high-resolution coastal or marine datasets. Their main spatial characteristics are summarized in Table 1 . For products originally distributed on angular grids, spatial resolutions are reported as approximate meter-scale ground spacing to facilitate comparison with the 30 m reference products. Specifically, the 1 arc-second NOAA CRM grid corresponds to approximately 30 m, the 15 arc-second GEBCO_2024 grid corresponds to approximately 450 m, and the 1/16 arc-minute EMODnet DTM grid corresponds to approximately 100 m near the equator. These values represent nominal ground spacing converted from the native angular grids; the actual east–west ground spacing varies with latitude.
blocks.zh: 纳入本研究的海拔产品包括全球陆地数据交换、全球背景测深以及区域高分辨率沿海或海洋数据集。 其主要空间特征见表1。 对于原分布在角网格上的产品,空间分辨率报告为近似度的地面间隔,以便于与30米参考产品进行比较。 具体来说,1弧秒的NOAA CRM网格对应约30米,15弧秒的GEBCO_2024网格对应约450米,1/16弧分钟EMODnet DTM网格对应约100米靠近赤道. 这些数值代表从原生角网转换出来的名义地面间隔;实际东西地面间隔随纬度而变化。

blocks.en:
TanDEM-X 30 m EDEM is used as the primary high-resolution terrestrial reference because it provides a globally consistent radar-derived representation of land topography with fine spatial resolution and homogeneous acquisition characteristics ( German Aerospace Center (2024), DLR ; Rizzoli et al., 2017 ) . GEBCO_2024 serves as the global ocean and background bathymetric product, providing broad terrain coverage in marine regions where direct high-resolution acoustic observations are sparse ( GEBCO Compilation
Group, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:

Four regional bathymetric products are further incorporated to improve the representation of high-resolution coastal and marine terrain. The refined 1 arcsec NOAA Coastal Relief Models (CRMs) from Vols. 1–5, 7, 9 and 10 provide ∼ \sim 30 m topographic–bathymetric surfaces for U.S. coastal zones and characterize land–ocean transition terrain ( NOAA National Centers for Environmental
Information, 2023 ) . The AusBathyTopo Torres Strait 30 m 2023 and Bass Strait 30 m 2022 datasets provide representative Australian reef–island and shallow-shelf bathymetry, respectively, with complex local gradients and smoother shelf backgrounds ( Geoscience
Australia, 2023 ; Geoscience Australia, 2022 ) .

blocks.en: Both terrestrial and marine DEM products are included during sample construction. The land DEM samples provide relatively abundant and structurally clear high-resolution terrain references, including elevation variation, slope transitions, ridge–valley morphology, and local relief patterns. Marine and coastal samples complement the land data with bathymetric surfaces and land–ocean transition structures, where high-resolution observations are usually sparser and more heterogeneous.
blocks.zh: 陆地和海洋DEM产品都包括在样品建造过程中。 陆地DEM样本提供了相对丰富和结构清晰的高分辨率地形参考,包括海拔变化、坡度过渡、山脊-Valley形态以及当地救济模式。 海洋和沿海样品以测深表面和陆地-海洋过渡结构补充陆地数据,其中高分辨率的观测通常比较稀少和多样。

blocks.en: All DEM and bathymetric products are processed under a unified GDAL-based geospatial workflow before sample construction. The original datasets are transformed to the WGS84 geographic coordinate system, converted to meter-based elevation or depth units when necessary, and standardized into GeoTIFF raster format. Nodata regions, abnormal elevation values, and invalid bathymetric cells are removed or excluded during preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 所有DEM和测深产品在采样施工前都要在基于GDAL的统一地理空间工作流程下处理. 原始数据集转换为WGS84地理坐标系统,必要时转换为基于米的海拔或深度单元,标准化为GeoTIFF光栅格式. 无数据区域、异常高程值和无效的测深单元格在预处理过程中被删除或排除在外。

blocks.en:
For paired or cross-product comparisons, LR and HR rasters are further co-registered and aligned on the raster grid before patch extraction. When products have different native resolutions or grid definitions, resampling is performed within the same GDAL-based workflow to ensure that paired samples correspond to the same geographic footprint. This alignment step reduces spatial mismatch among heterogeneous DEM products and provides spatially consistent patches for subsequent supervised reconstruction and evaluation.
The evaluation patches were generated through a predefined automated sampling and terrain-classification procedure without manual location selection.

blocks.en: External marine evaluation uses four regional source groups, identified as H 1 /H 2 –K in Fig. 3 . CHS NONNA-100 provides Canadian bathymetry distributed in geographic tiles; south of 68 ∘ 68^{\circ} N, the nominal source grid spacing is 0.001 ∘ 0.001^{\circ} ( Canadian Hydrographic Service, 2018 ) . The MH370 data provide bathymetric survey areas and track coverage in the southern Indian Ocean ( Geoscience Australia, 2018 ) . The Northern Australia 30 m product covers the northwestern–northern shelf within 121–133 ∘ E and 18–8 ∘ S ( Beaman, 2018 ) . The Great Barrier Reef 30 m product comprises overlapping regional blocks; B–D enter this evaluation, with A excluded because of spatial overlap with the main-study region ( Geoscience Australia, 2017 ) .

blocks.en: The selected subset contains 12 reference rasters, all prepared on a nominal 90 m evaluation grid from the source products listed in Table 1 . blocks.en: This section describes the proposed SCOPE network for continuous DEM reconstruction. As illustrated in Fig. 4 , the SCOPE network comprises a terrain encoder, the Neighborhood-Attentive Field (NAF) decoder, the Local Attentive Ensemble (LAE) module, and a bicubic base surface. The LR DEM is first encoded into an LR-aligned terrain feature field and transformed into a latent coefficient field. For a continuous query coordinate 𝐪 \mathbf{q} , NAF samples neighboring coefficient vectors and evaluates local residual candidates r i ​ ( 𝐪 ) r_{i}(\mathbf{q}) through local basis evaluation. LAE estimates compatibility weights among these candidates and fuses them into r ⁡ ( 𝐪 ) r(\mathbf{q}) , which is added to the bicubic base surface B ⁡ ( 𝐪 ) B(\mathbf{q}) to produce the reconstructed elevation z ^ ​ ( 𝐪 ) \widehat{z}(\mathbf{q}) .

blocks.en: The SCOPE network is required to model both positive and negative terrain residual responses. Positive residual responses may correspond to locally sharpened ridges, raised terrain details, or seabed features that are smoothed in the coarse DEM, whereas negative responses may correspond to incised channels, valleys, depressions, or local bathymetric troughs. To improve nonlinear residual representation, a parameter-free sign-adaptive activation function, termed the Sign-Adaptive Smooth Unit (SASU), is adopted in the elevation residual decoder.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置和结果

blocks.en: This section evaluates reconstruction under limited target-resolution supervision through component ablation, fixed-scale accuracy, terrain-structure assessment, cross-domain evaluation, and unseen-scale reconstruction. Cross-domain evaluation separates the existing paired-product experiment from frozen-model tests on external marine regions.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设计

blocks.en: The experiments evaluate SCOPE in terms of supervised-scale reconstruction, reconstruction beyond the supervised scale, terrain-structure preservation, and external transfer. The data construction protocol and study regions follow Sec. 2 . Training and validation regions are spatially separated before patch extraction, with no overlapping or adjacent patches across the two subsets. Gradient updates use the training subset; the validation subset supports training monitoring, checkpoint selection, and the main quantitative comparisons. The external marine data in Sec. 2.3 are reserved for frozen-model evaluation, with checkpoints fixed before external testing.
blocks.zh: 实验从监督规模的重建、超出监督规模的重建、地形结构的保护和外部转移等方面对SCOPE进行评价。 数据构建规程和研究区域遵循第2条. 培训和验证区域在补丁提取之前在空间上分离,两个子集之间没有重叠或相邻的补丁. 渐变更新使用培训子集;验证子集支持培训监测,检查点选择,以及主要的定量比较. 第2.3节的外部海洋数据用于冷冻模型评价,在外部测试前设置检查站。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, experiments are conducted under fixed 5 × 5\times supervised reconstruction. The physical-resolution protocol uses a nominal 450 m input grid and 90 m supervision. The fixed- 5 × 5\times model is subsequently evaluated at a nominal 30 m output grid ( 15 × 15\times ) over the same spatial footprint. SCOPE-5F uses 90 m training labels; 30 m target-resolution supervision is supplied to the explicitly identified SCOPE-15D and SCOPE-15FT controls. Native source-product resolution and training-label grid spacing are specified separately. LR inputs for training and validation are generated from HR DEMs by bicubic downsampling with antialiasing, and the validation scale remains fixed at 5 × 5\times . Elevation values are globally normalized after excluding the most extreme 0.1% of values. Land and marine samples are jointly used during training at a target ratio of 3:1, and all compared methods follow the same fixed- 5 × 5\times preprocessing and evaluation protocol. The 15 × 15\times evaluation uses the land portion of the fixed 5 × 5\times evaluation data.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,实验是在固定的5×5次监督重建下进行的. 物理分辨率协议使用标称的450米输入网格和90米监理. 固定-5×5\times模型随后以标称的30米输出网格(15×15\times)在同一空间足迹上进行评估. SCOPE-5F使用90米训练标签;30米目标分辨率监督提供给明确识别的SCOPE-15D和SCOPE-15FT控制. 本地源产品分辨率和培训标签网格间隔另行规定. 用于培训和验证的LR投入来自HR DEMs,通过双立式下取样与抗异名法生成,验证尺度仍固定在5×5\时. 在排除了最极端值的0.1%。 陆地和海洋样品在培训期间以3:1的目标比率共同使用,所有比较方法都遵循同样的固定-5×5的预处理和评价程序。 15×15\时评价采用固定5×5\时评价数据的土地部分.

blocks.en: SCOPE is implemented as a single-encoder continuous DEM reconstruction model. The terrain encoder follows a shifted-window Transformer design and is trained end-to-end within SCOPE to extract 192-dimensional terrain features. The Neighborhood-Attentive Field (NAF) decoder predicts latent coefficient fields instantiated with 96 basis frequencies. Four neighboring local residual candidates are fused by the Local Attentive Ensemble (LAE), added to the bicubic base surface with a residual scaling factor of 0.1, and passed through the post-refinement module in the full configuration. SASU is used as the default activation function.
blocks.zh: SCOPE作为单一编码器连续DEM重建模型实施. 地形编码器遵循转向窗变形器的设计,在SCOPE内部经过端对端的训练以提取192维地形特征. 邻域-加速场(NAF)解码器预测潜在系数场以96个基频率瞬间化. 4个相邻的局部残余候选者由局部运动阵列(LAE)熔化,加入双立体基面,剩余缩放系数为0.1,并在全构型中通过精炼后模块. SASU被用作默认的激活功能.

blocks.en: Model optimization follows an iteration-based protocol over approximately 230,000 LR–HR DEM patch pairs. Adam is used with a batch size of 6, an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , a minimum learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , and a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} . A cosine learning-rate schedule and gradient clipping with a maximum norm of 2.0 are adopted. Validation is performed every 2000 iterations, and the checkpoint with the best validation composite score is selected for the reported quantitative comparisons.
blocks.zh: 模型优化遵循基于迭代的协议,超过约23万LR–HR DEM补丁对. 亚当的用法为批量大小为6,初始学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}最低学习率为1×10×6 1\times 10×6}体重衰减为1×10×6 1\times 10×6}. 采用了最大规范为2.0的余弦学习率时间表和梯度剪接。 每2000年重复一次进行验证,并选择具有最佳验证综合分数的检查站进行报告的定量比较。

blocks.en: The training objective combines elevation reconstruction, gradient, and aspect losses with weights of 1.0, 0.05, and 0.01, respectively. Edge loss is disabled, and the aspect loss is computed only in valid sloped regions to avoid unstable directional supervision over nearly flat terrain.
blocks.zh: 培训目标将高架重建、梯度和侧面损失分别与1.0、0.05和0.01的重量结合起来。 边缘损失被取消,侧面损失仅在有效的坡度地区进行计算,以避免对近平坦地形进行不稳定的方向监督。

blocks.en: The compared methods include interpolation baselines, fixed-scale deep super-resolution models, and implicit neural reconstruction models. Learning-based baselines follow the same LR–HR data protocol whenever applicable. RMSE and MAE measure physical elevation errors in meters, while PSNR is reported in decibels. The table headings Slope, Aspect, and Corr. consistently denote the logged RMSE-Slope, RMSE-Aspect, and SlopeCorr metrics, respectively; Corr. measures slope consistency between reconstructed and reference terrain structures. Slope-related metrics are calculated with unit pixel spacing and quantify relative grid-space structure. Aspect errors use circular angular differences with a slope-based validity mask under the same convention. Lower RMSE, MAE, Slope, and Aspect and higher PSNR and Corr. indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 比较的方法包括内插基线,固定尺度的深超分辨率模型,以及隐含神经重建模型. 基于学习的基线在适用时遵循相同的LR-HR数据协议。 RMSE和MAE用米测量物理高程误差,而PSNR则用分贝仪报告。 表格标题Slope、Aspect和Corr. 一致表示已登录的RMSE-Slope、RMSE-Aspect和SlopeCorr 度量衡; Corr. 测量重构地形结构与参考地形结构之间的坡度一致性。 斯洛普相关度量衡以单位像素间距计算,量化相对网格-空间结构. 偏差使用圆角差异,在同一公约下带有坡度有效性罩。 下RMSE,MAE,Slope,以及Aspect和更高PSNR和Corr.显示性能较好.

blocks.en: PSNR is computed on globally normalized elevation arrays clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , using a unit data range.
blocks.zh: PSNR是利用一个单位数据范围,根据被剪切到[0,1][0,1]的全球正常高程阵列计算的.

blocks.en: For the external evaluation, the existing SCOPE-5F, EDSR, LIIF-MS, and EBCF-CDEM checkpoints are frozen. Every method is evaluated on the same 3,825 valid reference patches in each input setting, with bicubic interpolation retained as the non-learned baseline. RMSE and MAE are calculated per patch in the physical elevation domain in meters, and their arithmetic means are reported over all valid patches. Relative error reduction is 100 ​ ( E bicubic − E method ) / E bicubic 100(E_{\mathrm{bicubic}}-E_{\mathrm{method}})/E_{\mathrm{bicubic}} , so negative values indicate higher error. The final scale-transfer experiment compares unseen-scale inference, direct 15 × 15\times training, and 5 × 5\times training followed by 15 × 15\times fine-tuning to examine whether fixed 5 × 5\times supervision can support reconstruction at the unseen 15 × 15\times scale.
blocks.zh: 为进行外部评估,已冻结了SCOPE-5F、EDSR、LIF-MS和EBCF-CDEM检查站。 每种方法在每个输入设置中以相同的3,825个有效参考补丁进行评估,保留双曲线插值作为非学习基线. RMSE和MAE在物理高程域中按米数计算每个补丁,在所有有效补丁中报告其算术手段。 相对误差减少为100(E bicubic – E 方法) / E bicubic 100(E_{\ mathrm{bicubic}}-E_{\ mathrm{方法}})/E_{\ mathrm{bicubic}}),因此负值表示较高的误差. 最终的尺度转移实验比较了隐形尺度推论,直接15×15\时间训练,5×5\时间训练,之后15×15\时间微调,以检查固定5×5\时间监督能否支持隐形15×15\时间尺度的重建.

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented in PyTorch and conducted on a workstation equipped with a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU. A CUDA-enabled environment supports model optimization and evaluation. The same hardware and software environment is maintained across SCOPE, baseline methods, ablation variants, and scale-transfer experiments to ensure consistent comparison.
blocks.zh: 所有实验均在PyTorch进行,并在配备单NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPU的工作站上进行. 一个CUDA驱动的环境支持模型优化和评价. 整个SCOPE、基线方法、衰减变体和规模转移实验都维持同样的硬件和软件环境,以确保一致的比较。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Study on Key Components
blocks.zh: 4.2 对关键组成部分的研究

blocks.en: The ablation results in Table 2 indicate that the full SCOPE network configuration provides the most balanced performance in both elevation accuracy and terrain-structure preservation. Here, Corr. denotes the slope-consistency score between reconstructed and reference terrain structures. Removing the bicubic base surface produces a clear deterioration, with RMSE increasing from 4.150 to 4.682 and Corr. decreasing from 0.659 to 0.521, showing that a low-frequency terrain reference is important for stable continuous reconstruction. Substituting bilinear or nearest interpolation for the base surface causes only moderate changes, but both remain slightly weaker than the default bicubic base surface. Replacing LAE with bilinear fusion also leads to a small yet consistent decline, suggesting that local reliability-aware fusion helps preserve fine-scale relief variation.
blocks.zh: 表2中的衰减结果表明,整个SCOPE网络配置在海拔精确度和地形结构维护方面都提供了最平衡的性能。 在这里, Corr.表示重建的地形结构与参考地形结构之间的坡度一致性分数。 拆除双立方体基面会产生明显的恶化,RMSE从4.150增加到4.682和Corr.从0.659减少到0.521,表明低频地形参考对于稳定的连续重建很重要. 取代双线性或最近的插值来代替基底表面只会引起中等程度的变化,但两者都仍然略弱于默认的双线性基底表面. 用双线聚变取代LAE也会导致微小但持续的衰减,说明局部的可靠性感知聚变有助于保存细尺度的解变.

blocks.en: The refinement and loss-related variants mainly affect terrain morphology. Removing post-refinement markedly increases slope and aspect errors, indicating weaker control of local artifacts and high-frequency terrain details. The variant without the aspect-related loss shows the strongest degradation among the loss settings, especially in slope and aspect errors, which highlights the role of directional supervision in areas with complex local relief. Although the L1-only variant remains competitive in elevation accuracy, its weaker terrain-structure metrics show that elevation-wise fitting alone is insufficient for geomorphologically consistent DEM reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 修饰和损耗相关的变体主要影响地形形态. 消除后修整明显增加了坡度和侧面误差,表明对当地文物和高频地形细节的控制较弱. 没有与方面有关的损失的变体表明,损失环境的退化程度最大,特别是在坡度和方面错误方面,这突出表明了在当地救济复杂的地区进行定向监督的作用。 虽然只有L1的变体在海拔精确度方面仍然具有竞争力,但其较弱的地形结构衡量标准表明,仅靠海拔适配不足以进行地貌上一致的DEM重建。

blocks.en: The activation comparison further confirms the effectiveness of SASU as the default activation function in SCOPE. SiLU produces results very close to the full SASU-based model, suggesting that smooth gated nonlinearities are generally suitable for the elevation residual decoder. In contrast, GELU leads to a more evident degradation in both elevation accuracy and terrain-related metrics. Overall, the ablation study demonstrates that the bicubic base surface, adaptive local fusion, post-refinement operation, terrain-structure-aware supervision, and SASU activation jointly contribute to the final performance of the SCOPE network.
blocks.zh: 激活比较进一步证实了SASU作为SCOPE默认激活功能的有效性. SiLU产生的结果非常接近完全基于SASU的模型,表明平滑的门式非线性一般适合高架残余解码器. 相比之下,GELU导致海拔精确度和与地形有关的测量值更明显的退化。 总的来说,衰减研究表明,双立体基面,适应性局部聚变,精炼后操作,地形-结构-知觉监督,以及SASU激活共同促进了SCOPE网络的最终性能.

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study of the SCOPE network under the fixed 5 × 5\times reconstruction setting. Slope and Aspect denote slope-based and aspect-based reconstruction errors, respectively. Corr. denotes the slope-consistency score between reconstructed and reference terrain structures.
blocks.zh: 表2:在固定的5×5\时重建设置下,对SCOPE网络进行差化研究. Slope和Aspect分别表示基于斜坡和侧面的重建错误。 Corr.表示重建的地形结构与参考地形结构之间的坡度一致性分数。

blocks.en: ↓ \downarrow indicates that a lower value is better, while ↑ \uparrow indicates that a higher value is better.
blocks.zh: \\ downarrow 表示下值更好, 而\\ oparrow 表示上值更好 。

blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 与基线的定量比较

blocks.en: The quantitative comparison in Table 3 evaluates the SCOPE network against interpolation methods, fixed-scale super-resolution networks, and implicit neural reconstruction baselines under the fixed 5 × 5\times setting. Under this supervised scale, the SCOPE network ranks first across all six evaluation metrics. Relative to the strongest non-SCOPE result for each metric, RMSE, MAE, and slope error are reduced by 6.04%, 5.28%, and 7.16%, respectively. Aspect error is reduced by 1.21%, while PSNR and Corr. increase by 1.32 dB and 0.019. EBCF-CDEM is highly efficient with only 1.450M parameters and 11.153 GMACs. Compared with LIIF and LTE, SCOPE reduces the counted GMACs by 79.77% and 77.62%, respectively, while achieving the best overall reconstruction performance.
blocks.zh: 表3中的定量比较参照插值方法,固定尺度的超分辨率网络,以及固定5×5\时间设置下的隐含神经重建基线,评价了SCOPE网络. 在这个监督的尺度下,SCOPE网络在所有六个评价指标中排名第一。 相对最强的非SCOPE结果而言,RMSE、MAE和坡度误差分别减少6.04%、5.28%和7.16%。 偏差减少1.21%,而PSNR和Corr增加1.32 dB和0.019. EBCF-CDEM效率很高,只有1.450M参数和11.153GMAC. 与LIIF和LTE相比,SCOPE将计数的GMAC分别减少了79.77%和77.62%,同时实现了最佳的整体重建绩效.

blocks.en: EDSR obtains the second-best RMSE, MAE, and slope error. Bicubic interpolation ranks second in aspect, PSNR, and Corr. SCOPE achieves the leading result across both elevation and terrain-structure metrics.
blocks.zh: EDSR获得第二佳的RMSE,MAE和坡度误差. bicubic内插值在PSNR和Corr方面排名第二。 SCOPE在海拔和地形结构两方面都取得了领先成果。

blocks.en: Among the INR-based methods, EBCF-CDEM obtains the lowest RMSE and MAE, showing competitive pointwise elevation fitting, but its slope, aspect, PSNR, and Corr. results are weaker than those of LIIF. LIIF is therefore used as the main INR-style visual baseline in the following qualitative comparison, while EBCF-CDEM remains the closest DEM-specific continuous reconstruction baseline in the quantitative analysis. Overall, the fixed-scale results indicate that the SCOPE network provides a more balanced reconstruction than interpolation, grid-based learning, and implicit neural representation baselines.
blocks.zh: 在基于国家自然资源研究所的方法中,欧洲生物浓缩和生物浓缩基金 -- -- CDEM获得了最低的RMSE和MAE, 显示出有竞争力的点位海拔配置,但其坡度、侧面、PSNR和Corr.结果比LIIF差。 因此,在以下质量比较中,LIIF被用作国家自然资源研究所式的主要视觉基线,而欧洲生物浓缩基金-CDEM仍然是量化分析中最接近的针对德国的连续重建基线。 总体而言,固定尺度的结果表明,SCOPE网络提供的重建比插图,网格学习和隐含神经表达基线更平衡.

blocks.en: Table 3: Quantitative comparison with interpolation, fixed-scale super-resolution, and implicit neural reconstruction baselines under the fixed 5 × 5\times setting. All baseline architectures follow their official implementations or recommended model configurations and are trained and evaluated under the unified data and evaluation protocol. Params and GMACs are reported for batch size 1 with a 40 × 40 40\times 40 LR input and a 200 × 200 200\times 200 output, counting convolution, linear projection, attention matrix multiplication, and explicit basis-evaluation matrix multiplication. Red and blue indicate the best and second-best results for each metric, respectively. Lower RMSE, MAE, Slope, and Aspect indicate better performance, while higher PSNR and Corr. indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 表3:与内插,固定尺度超分辨率,以及固定5×5\时设置下的隐含神经重建基线进行定量比较. 所有基线架构都遵循其正式实施或推荐的模型配置,并根据统一的数据和评价协议进行培训和评价。 参数和GMAC在批量1中报告,输入量为40×40 40\时,输入量为40LR,输出量为200×200 200\时,计数演化,线性预测,注意力矩阵乘法,以及明确的基础评价矩阵乘法. 红色和蓝色分别表明每个衡量标准的最佳和次最佳结果。 下RMSE,MAE,Slope,和Aspect表示性能较好,而较高的PSNR和Corr表示性能较好.

blocks.en: 4.4 Fixed-Scale Visual Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 固定规模视觉分析

blocks.en: The figures show representative land and marine examples, and quantitative metrics are computed over the complete predefined evaluation set. The qualitative comparisons include bicubic interpolation, the fixed-scale models EDSR and SwinIR, and the continuous reconstruction models LIIF and EBCF-CDEM. EBCF-CDEM provides the DEM-specific continuous reconstruction comparison.
blocks.zh: 这些数字显示了具有代表性的陆地和海洋实例,量化的衡量尺度是根据完整的预先界定的评价组合计算的。 质的比较包括双立体插值,EDSR和SwinIR的固定尺度模型,以及连续重建模型LIIF和ECF-CDEM. ECF-CDEM提供了针对DEM的连续重建比较.

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Visual Reconstruction Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 视觉重建比较

blocks.en: To further examine fixed-scale reconstruction behavior, representative land and marine patches are visualized under the supervised 5 × 5\times setting. As shown in Figs. 5 and 6 , the comparison includes the HR reference, the LR input, bicubic interpolation, EDSR, SwinIR, LIIF, EBCF-CDEM, and the SCOPE network, with local enlargements highlighting fine-scale terrain details and geomorphological structures.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步审查固定规模的重建行为,代表性的陆地和海洋补丁在监督的5×5\时间设置下可视化. 如图5和图6所示,比较内容包括:HR参考、LR输入、双曲线插图、EDSR、SwinIR、LIF、EBCF-CDEM和SCOPE网络,当地扩展突出细尺度地形细节和地貌结构。

blocks.en: For the land patch, the LR input loses most narrow valley and ridge details, while bicubic interpolation restores the broad elevation pattern but produces an overly smooth surface. EDSR, SwinIR, and LIIF recover more coherent terrain than interpolation, yet small ridge–valley transitions and local elevation contrasts remain softened. For the marine and coastal patch, smooth bathymetric areas coexist with sharper nearshore transitions; here, LR degradation and bicubic interpolation weaken local gradients, and EDSR, SwinIR, and LIIF still blur subtle bathymetric and coastal relief variations. EBCF-CDEM remains important, but nearest-neighbor basing causes block artifacts in the marine example. In contrast, the SCOPE network better preserves valley continuity, ridge-like transitions, coastal gradients, and fine-scale relief variations, producing reconstructions that are visually closer to the HR reference. These observations are consistent with Table 3 , where the SCOPE network achieves the best overall performance across elevation accuracy and terrain-related metrics.
blocks.zh: 对于陆地补丁来说,LR输入损失了大多数狭窄的谷地和山脊细节,而双立体插值则恢复了宽高的图案,但产生了过于光滑的表面. EDSR、SwinIR和LIF恢复了比内插更为连贯的地形,但小山脊-Valley过渡和局部海拔对比仍然很软。 对于海洋和沿海区,光滑的测深区与更尖锐的近岸过渡共存;在这里,LR退化和双立体插值削弱了局部梯度,EDSR,SwinIR,和LIIF仍然模糊了细微的测深和海岸救济变异. EBCF-CDEM仍然很重要,但以海洋为例,最近的邻里堆积了文物。 相比之下,SCOPE网络更好地保存了山谷的连续性,山脊状的过渡,海岸梯度,以及细度的救援变异,产生了视觉上更接近HR参考的重建. 这些观测结果与表3一致,该表显示SCOPE网络在海拔精确度和与地形有关的指标方面的总体性能最佳。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Fixed-scale visual comparison on a representative land patch under the 5 × 5\times reconstruction setting. Panels (a)–(g) show the LR input, bicubic interpolation, EDSR, SwinIR, LIIF, EBCF-CDEM, and the SCOPE network, respectively, while panel (h) shows the GT HR DEM. All panels are compared over the same elevation range. The enlarged regions highlight local terrain details, where the SCOPE network better preserves ridge–valley structures and fine-scale relief variations.
blocks.zh: 图5:5×5\时重建设置下代表性土地补丁的固定规模直观比较. 专门小组(a)-(g)分别显示LR输入、双立插、EDSR、SwinIR、LIIF、ECF-CDEM和SCOPE网络,而专门小组(h)显示GT HR DEM。 所有面板都在同一海拔范围内进行比较。 扩大的区域突出局部地形细节,SCOPE网络更好地保护山脊-Valley结构和细微的救灾变化。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Fixed-scale visual comparison on a representative marine and coastal patch under the 5 × 5\times reconstruction setting. Panels (a)–(g) show the LR input, bicubic interpolation, EDSR, SwinIR, LIIF, EBCF-CDEM, and the SCOPE network, respectively, while panel (h) shows the GT HR DEM. All panels are shown with a shared elevation range. The enlarged regions illustrate the reconstruction of coastal and bathymetric transition structures, where the SCOPE network produces a sharper and more coherent terrain surface.
blocks.zh: 图6:在5×5\时重建环境下对具有代表性的海洋和海岸斑块进行固定规模的直观比较。 专门小组(a)-(g)分别显示LR输入、双立插、EDSR、SwinIR、LIIF、ECF-CDEM和SCOPE网络,而专门小组(h)显示GT HR DEM。 所有面板都显示在共同的海拔范围内。 扩大的区域表明沿海和测深过渡结构的重建,SCOPE网络在其中产生了更尖锐和更连贯的地形表面。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Elevation Error Distribution and Profile Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 升空错误分布和剖面分析

blocks.en: The absolute elevation-error maps and elevation profiles jointly reveal the spatial distribution and local magnitude of reconstruction errors. As shown in Figs. 7 and 8 , the LR input produces strong block-related errors around narrow valleys, ridge boundaries, coastal slopes, and bathymetric transition zones. Bicubic interpolation reduces part of these artifacts but leaves evident errors along terrain boundaries, indicating that smooth interpolation cannot recover missing high-frequency relief structures.
blocks.zh: 绝对高程-高程图和高程剖面图共同揭示了重建错误的空间分布和当地规模。 如图7和图8所示,LR输入在狭窄的河谷、山脊边界、沿海坡度和测深过渡区周围产生与块有关的强烈误差。 bicubic内插减少了这些文物的一部分,但沿地形边界留下明显的误差,表明平滑内插无法恢复缺失的高频救援结构.

blocks.en: Compared with bicubic interpolation, EDSR, SwinIR, and LIIF reduce part of the large-scale error but still show structured deviations where elevation changes rapidly. EBCF-CDEM is close to SCOPE, but SCOPE gives lower errors, especially along coastal transitions. In contrast, the SCOPE network exhibits a more spatially restrained error distribution, with fewer high-error responses in the enlarged regions. This indicates that SCOPE reduces not only average elevation deviation but also structured errors associated with complex terrain transitions.
blocks.zh: 与双立体插值相比,EDSR,SwinIR和LIIF减少了部分大规模误差,但仍在海拔变化迅速的地方显示出结构偏差. EBCF-CDEM与SCOPE相近,但SCOPE的误差较低,特别是沿海岸过渡. 相比之下,SCOPE网络显示出空间限制性更强的误差分布,在扩大的区域,高误差反应较少。 这表明,SCOPE不仅减少平均海拔偏差,而且减少与复杂地形过渡有关的结构化错误。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Absolute elevation-error comparison on the representative land patch under the fixed 5 × 5\times reconstruction setting. Panels (a)–(g) show the absolute elevation errors of the LR input, bicubic interpolation, EDSR, SwinIR, LIIF, EBCF-CDEM, and the SCOPE network, respectively, with respect to the GT HR DEM shown in panel (h). The enlarged regions highlight error distributions around local ridge–valley structures.
blocks.zh: 图7:在固定的5×5\次重建情况下,对具有代表性的地块进行绝对高程-高程比较。 小组(a)-(g)分别显示LR输入、双立插、EDSR、SwinIR、LIF、EBCF-CDEM和SCOPE网络在小组(h)中显示的GT HR DEM的绝对高差。 扩大的区域突出显示当地山脊-Valley结构周围的错误分布。

Panels (a)–(g) show the absolute elevation errors of the LR input, bicubic interpolation, EDSR, SwinIR, LIIF, EBCF-CDEM, and the SCOPE network, respectively, with respect to the GT HR DEM shown in panel (h). The enlarged regions emphasize errors near coastal and bathymetric transition zones.
blocks.zh: 图8:在固定的5×5\时间重建情况下,对具有代表性的海洋和沿海区块进行绝对高程-高程比较。 小组(a)-(g)分别显示LR输入、双立插、EDSR、SwinIR、LIF、EBCF-CDEM和SCOPE网络在小组(h)中显示的GT HR DEM的绝对高差。 扩大的区域强调沿海和测深过渡区附近的错误。

blocks.en: The profile comparison in Fig. 9 further assesses local elevation fidelity. All methods broadly follow the large-scale elevation trend, but differences remain around local peaks, valleys, and rapidly changing slopes. The LR profile shows step-like variations, bicubic interpolation smooths local extremes, and LIIF underestimates or slightly shifts several peak–valley amplitudes. EDSR and SwinIR follow the HR trajectory closely and remain strong fixed-scale elevation baselines, consistent with Table 3 ; however, their weaker aspect and Corr. metrics indicate that elevation fitting alone does not ensure terrain-structure consistency. EBCF-CDEM follows SCOPE closely, but larger local interpolation deviations remain. Compared with EDSR and SwinIR, the SCOPE network maintains similar or better profile fidelity while improving directional and geomorphological consistency under the fixed 5 × 5\times setting.
blocks.zh: 图9的概况比较进一步评估了当地高地的忠诚度。 所有方法都大致遵循大规模海拔趋势,但当地山峰、山谷和迅速变化的山坡周围仍存在差异。 LR剖面显示步态变异,双曲线插值平滑局部极端,LIIF低估或略微移动几个峰值-Valley振幅. EDSR和SwinIR与表3一致,密切遵循人力资源轨迹,保持强势的固定高度基线;然而,其较弱的方面和Corr.指标表明,仅靠海拔配置并不能确保地形结构的一致性。 EBCF-CDEM紧密跟随SCOPE,但仍有较大的局部内插偏差. 与EDSR和SwinIR相比,SCOPE网络在固定的5×5\时间设置下保持相似或更好的剖面忠诚,同时提高方向性和地貌一致性.

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Directional Terrain Structure Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 定向地形结构分析

blocks.en: The aspect visualizations further examine whether the reconstructed DEMs preserve directionally consistent terrain structures. As shown in Figs. 10 and 11 , the HR aspect maps exhibit organized directional patterns along ridge flanks, valley sides, coastal slopes, and bathymetric transition zones. These patterns are strongly degraded in the LR input, where coarse sampling produces block-like and locally inconsistent aspect responses. Bicubic interpolation partially restores directional continuity, but the recovered aspect fields remain over-smoothed, with weakened transitions around complex terrain boundaries.
blocks.zh: 该方面可视化进一步审查重建后的DEM是否保持了方向一致的地形结构。 如图10和图11所示,人力资源图沿山脊侧翼、河谷侧面、沿海坡面和测深过渡区展示了有组织的方向图。 这些模式在LR输入中严重退化,粗细的取样产生类似块的局部不一致的方面反应。 bicubic内插部分恢复了方向连续性,但恢复的侧面场仍保持过沉,在复杂地形边界周围的过渡减弱.

blocks.en: EDSR, SwinIR, and LIIF recover plausible large-scale aspect patterns, but local artifacts remain: EDSR and SwinIR produce smoother, interpolation-like directional textures, whereas LIIF shows more regular block-like patterns in several enlarged areas. EBCF-CDEM preserves broad directions, but block-like aspect artifacts remain near complex transitions. In contrast, the SCOPE network better preserves fine-scale directional variations while maintaining spatial coherence. Its aspect fields are closer to the HR reference, with clearer local directional bands and fewer artificial discontinuities, supporting the quantitative improvement in the aspect-related metric and the preservation of local slope-facing direction.
blocks.zh: EDSR,SwinIR,和LIF恢复了可能存在的大规模侧面图案,但当地文物仍然存在:EDSR和SwinIR产生较平滑,内插的定向纹理,而LIIF在几个扩大的区域内显示出更规律的块状图案. EBCF-CDEM保留了大方向,但类似块状的方面文物仍然接近复杂的过渡. 相比之下,SCOPE网络在保持空间一致性的同时更好地保留了细尺度的方向性变化. 其侧面领域更接近人力资源参考,局部方向波段更清晰,人工断层较少,支持了侧面相关度量的定量改进,也支持了对局部斜坡向的维护.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Crossing the Supervision Boundary: From Known Scales to Unseen Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 5.1 跨越监督边界:从已知的尺度到不明的重建

blocks.en: The reconstruction problem considered here combines a supervision constraint with a computational requirement: labels are available at a coarser output resolution, while deployment may request a denser terrain grid. SCOPE addresses this combination through reusable coefficient-field prediction rather than through continuous coordinate querying alone. The fixed- 5 × 5\times to unseen- 15 × 15\times experiment evaluates this design outside the supervised output scale, increasing the query density ninefold without additional target-scale training labels.
blocks.zh: 这里考虑的重建问题将监督约束与计算要求结合起来:标签可以在较宽的输出分辨率下获得,而部署可能要求更密集的地形网格. SCOPE通过可重复使用的系数-场预测,而不是仅通过连续的坐标查询来解决这种组合. 固定的 - 5×5\时间到幽灵的 - 15×15\时间的实验在受监督的输出尺度之外评价这种设计,将查询密度提高9倍,而没有额外的目标尺度训练标签.

blocks.en: SCOPE supports this transition by separating terrain representation learning from output-grid construction. A latent coefficient field is learned on the LR feature grid and parameterizes reusable local elevation-residual functions. Changing the reconstruction factor therefore does not require a new scale-specific output head or a different terrain representation; only the density at which the coefficient field is evaluated is altered. The bicubic base preserves the broad elevation trend, while local basis evaluation and LAE reconstruct terrain variations from neighboring coefficient vectors. This design makes the reconstructed surface depend on a reusable terrain field rather than on isolated query-wise elevation answers.
blocks.zh: SCOPE通过将地形代表性学习与产出网建设分开来支持这一过渡. 在LR特征网格上学习了潜在系数域,参数化了可重复使用的局部高程剩余函数. 因此,改变重建因子不需要一个新的特定比例的输出头或不同的地形代表;只有评价系数字段的密度才会改变。 双立体基保持了广阔的海拔趋势,而局部基础评估和LAE则从相邻的系数矢量重建地形变化. 这种设计使得重建的地表依赖于可重复使用的地形场,而不是孤立的基于查询的海拔答案.

blocks.en: The land scale-transfer results support the usefulness of the learned representation beyond its supervised resolution. With the input held at nominal 450 m spacing, the model trained against 90 m labels remains effective when queried at 30 m. Direct target-scale training and fine-tuning yield results close to those of the fixed- 5 × 5\times model. The evidence therefore supports useful reconstruction with supervision at the coarser output resolution, without requiring a claim that fixed-scale training is intrinsically superior to the alternative protocols.
blocks.zh: 土地规模转让的结果证明,在有监督地解决问题之外,学到的代表权是有用的。 在标称450米间距的输入中,在30米处被询问时,用90米标签培训的模型仍然有效。 直接目标规模培训和微调的结果接近于固定-5×5\时模式的结果。 因此,证据支持在压缩器输出分辨率的监督下进行有益的重建,而不需要声称固定规模的培训在本质上优于替代协议。

blocks.en: 5.2 Implications for Earth Observation Terrain Products
blocks.zh: 5.2 对地面观测产品的影响

blocks.en: The coefficient-field formulation allows a terrain representation learned from available paired data to be evaluated on different output grids. For applications requiring finer sampling than the training references provide, this can reduce dependence on separate scale-specific models and target-resolution training labels. The land results demonstrate a useful case: a model trained with nominal 90 m supervision improves on interpolation when evaluated against 30 m references. The deployment value lies in flexible reconstruction from existing products, rather than in replacing new terrain observations.
blocks.zh: 系数-场配方允许从现有配对数据中吸取的地形代表值在不同产出网格上进行评价。 对于比培训参考文献提供的更精细取样的应用程序,这可以减少对不同比例模型和目标分辨率培训标签的依赖。 土地结果显示了一个有用的案例:一个经过名义上90米监督的模型,在对照30米的参考值进行评估时,改进了内插。 部署价值在于利用现有产品进行灵活的重建,而不是取代新的地形观测。

blocks.en: The external marine tests clarify a separate requirement for such use. Under self-downsampling, SCOPE retains an accuracy advantage on the held-out regions, whereas matched GEBCO inputs do not yield a gain over bicubic. Its cross-product elevation errors are close to EDSR, and LIIF-MS leads the Aspect and Corr. metrics despite its large elevation errors. The earlier matched-product experiment also distributes the best metrics across SCOPE-Direct, SCOPE-Transfer, and bicubic. These metric-specific rankings do not establish a uniform cross-product advantage. Regional generalization under a common degradation model and transfer between real products are therefore different capabilities. Differences in acquisition source, vertical reference, interpolation history, and terrain distribution can affect matched-product reconstruction; the aggregate results do not isolate their individual contributions.
blocks.zh: 外部海洋试验澄清了单独使用的要求。 在自下采样下,SCOPE保留了被搁置区域的准确性优势,而匹配的GEBCO投入不会比双立方体产生收益. 它的跨产品高程误差接近EDSR,而LIIF-MS则领导着Aspect和Corr. 度量衡,尽管它存在很大的高程误差. 较早的配对产品实验还在整个SCOPE-Direct,SCOPE-Transfer,和双立方体中分布了最好的度量衡. 这些具体计量的排名并没有建立统一的跨产品优势. 因此,按照共同的退化模式进行区域通用以及实际产品之间的转让是不同的能力。 收购来源、纵向参考、插图历史和地形分布的差异可能影响匹配产品重建;总结果并不孤立它们各自的贡献。

blocks.en: 5.3 Why Lightweight Local Attentive Ensemble Is Sufficient
blocks.zh: 5.3 轻量级地方活动组合为何足够

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that LAE provides small but consistent improvements over Transformer-style fusion across the terrain-related metrics. At each query coordinate 𝐪 \mathbf{q} , the fusion module receives only four local residual candidates r i ​ ( 𝐪 ) r_{i}(\mathbf{q}) together with their relative displacements Δ ​ 𝐪 i \Delta\mathbf{q}_{i} . Its role is therefore not to learn long-range interactions or rich token dependencies, but to estimate compatibility weights for a compact set of geometry-related residual candidates.
blocks.zh: 表7显示,LAE比变形器式聚变在地形相关指标上提供小而一致的改进. 在每次查询坐标q\ mathbf{q}中,聚变模块只接收4个本地剩余候选者r i (q) r_{i} (\ mathbf{q}) 及其相对的迁移 q i\ Delta\ mathbf{q}_{i}. 因此,它的作用不是学习远距离相互作用或丰富的象征依赖性,而是估计一组紧凑的几何相关剩余候选者的兼容性权重.

blocks.en: Transformer-style fusion remains a powerful general interaction mechanism, particularly for feature extraction and larger token sets, as already exploited by the upstream encoder. At the query stage, however, most terrain context has been encoded into the latent coefficient field, leaving only a low-dimensional local aggregation problem. LAE introduces a more direct inductive bias by mapping local residual candidates and geometric offsets to adaptive compatibility weights. Its slightly lower elevation and terrain-structure errors indicate that this compact weighting mechanism is sufficient for local basis evaluation, while avoiding unnecessary query-side complexity.
blocks.zh: 变形器式的聚变仍是一种强大的一般相互作用机制,特别是对于地物提取器和更大的符号集而言,上游编码器已经利用了这种机制。 然而,在查询阶段,大多数地形上下文已被编码成潜伏系数域,只留下一个低维局部聚合问题. LAE通过绘制局部残基和几何抵消以适应性兼容权重来引入更直接的诱导偏差. 其略低的海拔和地形结构误差表明,这种紧凑的加权机制足以进行局部基础评价,同时避免不必要的查询-侧式复杂.

blocks.en: Table 7: Comparison between MLP-based LAE and Transformer-style local fusion. Lower values indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 表7:基于MLP的LAE和变形器风格的局部聚变的比较. 数值较低表明业绩较好。

blocks.en: 5.4 Effect of Sign-Adaptive Activation
blocks.zh: 5.4 信号加速的作用

blocks.en: The activation ablation shows lower errors with SASU than with GELU in the reported run, reducing RMSE from 4.404 to 4.150 and grid-space slope error from 14.939 to 12.051. SASU and SiLU produce nearly identical results. SASU is retained as the default activation, while the comparison supports the use of smooth gated nonlinearities without establishing a substantial advantage over SiLU.
blocks.zh: 激活衰减显示,在所报运行中,SASU的误差低于GELU, RMSE从4.404降至4.150,网格-空间坡差从14.939降至12.051。 SASU和SiLU的结果几乎相同。 SASU作为默认激活被保留,而比较则支持使用平滑的闸门非线性,而没有确立比SILU的实质性优势.

blocks.en: SASU applies different smooth nonlinear responses to non-negative and negative activations without introducing additional parameters, providing a lightweight component for residual decoding.
blocks.zh: SASU在不引入附加参数的情况下对非负和负激活应用不同的平滑非线性反应,为剩余解码提供了轻量级组件.

blocks.en: 5.5 Computational Scaling and Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.5 计算放大和推论效率

blocks.en: The Params and GMACs reported in Tables 3 and 6 show a distinct computational response to denser querying. When the reconstruction scale increases from 5 × 5\times to 15 × 15\times , the counted GMACs increase by only 0.515 for SCOPE, compared with 819.528 for LIIF and 73.646 for EBCF-CDEM. This contrast arises from what is repeated during HR querying. Query-wise implicit baselines repeatedly apply linear layers in an MLP to dense HR coordinates, whereas SCOPE generates a latent coefficient field once from spatially organized LR feature maps. The query coordinate then mainly triggers coefficient sampling, basis-function combination, and lightweight LAE weighting, rather than another high-dimensional coordinate-to-elevation regression. This computational distinction can be summarized as

blocks.en: 5.6 Limitations and Extensions toward Latent Geomorphological Prior Learning
blocks.zh: 5.6 向晚期地貌学前学习的局限性和延伸

blocks.en: SCOPE remains a paired grid-space reconstruction method, constrained by the information, noise, and uncertainty in the observed LR–HR products. The main quantitative comparisons use the validation subset employed for checkpoint selection, rather than a separate held-out main-study test set; the external marine experiment provides a distinct frozen-model evaluation. The present 15 × 15\times accuracy results cover land terrain because some regional 30 m marine products contain stronger local noise. Independently referenced 30 m bathymetric reconstruction is outside this evaluation. Small differences among training protocols and activations are reported descriptively, without a claim of statistical significance.
blocks.zh: SCOPE仍然是一对网格空间重建方法,受到所观测到的LR-HR产品的信息、噪音和不确定性的限制。 主要的定量比较使用用于检查点选择的验证子集,而不是单独的搁置式主研究测试集;外部海洋实验提供了独特的冷冻模型评价. 目前15x15的准确性结果覆盖了陆地地形,因为约30米的区域海洋产品含有更强烈的局部噪音。 独立参考的30米测深重建不属于本评价的范围。 培训协议和启动程序之间的细微差异以描述方式报告,没有说明统计意义。

blocks.en: The geographic scope is bounded by the selected regions and sampling protocol. Polar and high-latitude terrain outside 65 ∘ 65^{\circ} N– 65 ∘ 65^{\circ} S is excluded because snow and ice cover, sparse observations, complex surface conditions, and vertical-reference differences introduce additional uncertainty. The external marine aggregate is patch-weighted and dominated by the Northern Australia and Great Barrier Reef groups, rather than equally weighted by source or representative of global bathymetry. Regional holdout does not establish independence of the underlying surveys incorporated into different bathymetric compilations. Similarly, the source-product extents and tile-index boundaries in Fig. 3 indicate geographic context, not uninterrupted valid observations or complete tested coverage.
blocks.zh: 地理范围受选定区域和取样协议的约束。 北纬65度以外的极地和高纬度地形 S被排除在外,因为雪和冰覆盖,观测很少,地表条件复杂,以及垂直参照差异都带来了额外的不确定性. 外部海洋总量是补丁加权的,以澳大利亚北部和大堡礁群为主,而不是按来源或代表全球水深的等量加权。 区域搁置并不确立纳入不同测深汇编的基础调查的独立性。 同样,图3中的源产品范围及瓷砖指数边界表示地理背景,不是不间断的有效观测,也不是经过测试的完全覆盖.

blocks.en: Grid spacing and evaluation metrics also delimit interpretation. The common 90 m external grid is a processing convention rather than a guarantee of effective 90 m bathymetric detail. Slope-related metrics use unit pixel spacing and assess grid-space structure rather than physical slope errors at 90 m or 30 m horizontal spacing. Fine-scale reconstruction remains an inference constrained by LR observations and learned terrain priors; it should not be interpreted as newly observed topographic measurements.
blocks.zh: 网格间隔和评价指标也划定了解释范围。 常见的90米外部网格是一种加工惯例,而不是保证有效的90米深密. 与斯洛普相关的度量衡使用单位像素间距并评估网格-空间结构,而不是90米或30米水平间距的物理坡度误差. 精细规模的重建仍然是受到LR观测和所学地形前科的制约的推论;它不应被解释为新观察到的地形测量.

blocks.en: A more fundamental extension would be to move beyond grid-space sharpening toward latent geomorphological prior learning. LR and HR DEMs could be jointly embedded into a shared high-dimensional terrain manifold, where cross-scale consistency, basis-structured terrain variation, slope–aspect geometry, and terrain-type semantics are explicitly constrained. This direction should be distinguished from directly adopting codebook-based or diffusion-based image super-resolution: although learned latent priors have reduced ambiguity in restoration tasks ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Gu et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2023 ) , DEM reconstruction requires stronger physical and geomorphological control. Future work may therefore explore latent terrain-atlas learning, cross-scale representation alignment, uncertainty-aware constraints, and multi-source geospatial priors.
blocks.zh: 更根本的延伸将是超越网格空间的磨损,走向潜在的地貌学先行学习。 LR和HR DEMs可以共同嵌入一个共同的高维地形多维,其中跨尺度一致性、基础结构的地形变化、坡度几何和地形类型的语义都受到明确限制。 这一方向应该区别于直接采用基于密码本或基于传播的图像超分辨率:虽然所学的潜在前科降低了修复任务的模糊性(van den Oord等人,2017年;Esser等人,2021年;周等人,2022年;Gu等人,2022年;Saharia等人,2023年),DEM重建需要更强的物理和地貌控制. 因此,今后的工作可能探索潜在的地形-地图集学习、跨规模的表示协调、对不确定性的认知限制和多来源地理空间前科。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study addresses continuous DEM reconstruction when paired training data are available at a lower reconstruction factor but labels at the desired target factor are unavailable for training. SCOPE learns a reusable coefficient field from the available pairs and reconstructs a denser elevation grid through local basis evaluation and geometry-guided ensemble fusion. The same design reduces the high-dimensional prediction repeated across output coordinates, addressing target-scale supervision constraints and computational growth together.
blocks.zh: 这项研究涉及在重建系数较低的情况下提供配对培训数据,但无法在理想的目标系数上标注培训内容时的连续重建。 SCOPE从可用的对子中学习一个可重复使用的系数场,并通过局部基础评估和几何导变聚重建更密集的海拔网格. 同样的设计降低了跨输出坐标重复的高维度预测,解决了目标尺度的监管制约,并共同计算增长.

blocks.en: Under fixed 5 × 5\times supervision, SCOPE ranks first across six metrics in the main supervised-scale evaluation. In the land evaluation at the unseen 15 × 15\times factor, it reduces RMSE and MAE by approximately 12% relative to bicubic, with RMSE within 0.08% of target-scale fine-tuning. Ninefold output density increases the counted computation by approximately 2%. Together, these results support effective reconstruction beyond the supervised resolution with low incremental arithmetic cost.
blocks.zh: 在固定的5×5\的监管下,SCOPE在主要监督级评价中在6个度数中排名第一. 在未见15×15\时间系数的土地评估中,与双丘比克相比,RMSE和MAE减少约12%,RMSE在目标规模微调的0.08%以内. 九倍输出密度使计数计算增加约2%. 这些成果加在一起有助于有效重建,使其超出监督解决范围,增加的计算成本较低。

blocks.en: Frozen-model validation on 3,825 held-out external marine patches complements the scale-transfer evidence. Relative to the DEM-specific EBCF-CDEM baseline, SCOPE reduces RMSE by approximately 19% under self-downsampling and 2% with matched GEBCO_2023 inputs, and yields lower RMSE than LIIF-MS in both settings. It leads all six metrics under self-downsampling and the learned models in RMSE, MAE, Slope, and PSNR under matched cross-product inputs. Together, the supervised-scale, unseen-scale, and external evaluations support reusable terrain functions as an effective approach to scale-flexible DEM reconstruction under limited target-resolution supervision.
blocks.zh: 对3,825件搁置的外部海洋补丁进行冻模验证,补充了规模转移证据。 相对于特定德国德国的ECF-CDEM基线,SCOPE在自下采样下将RMSE减少约19%,并用匹配的GEBCO_2023投入减少2%,在两种情况下RMSE的产量都低于LIIF-MS. 它在自下采样下领导所有6个衡量标准,在RMSE、MAE、Slope和PSNR中,在相应的交叉产品投入下领导学习模型。 监督规模、无形规模和外部评价共同支持可重复使用的地形功能,作为在有限的目标分辨率监督下进行规模灵活DEM重建的有效方法。
